roadmap.title: Shared model/tool loop
roadmap.gate: A real model reads a current entity through the existing dispatcher and receives the actual result; failures cannot complete the task.
roadmap.dependencies: Typed assistant/tool messages, host grants, accumulated streamed calls and cancellation.

roadmap.title: Durable jobs and agent specs
roadmap.gate: One accepted lease/commit under competing workers; crash/restart preserves status, evidence and cancellation.
roadmap.dependencies: Tool-loop results, persisted state machine, lease and idempotence contracts.

roadmap.title: Reusable creation recipes
roadmap.gate: A behavior-validated artifact becomes a persisted recipe that improves a later task.
roadmap.dependencies: Durable task binding, goal-level validators and repair/recipe memory.

roadmap.title: Artifact recovery and portability
roadmap.gate: Exact empty/binary/Unicode round trips; active corruption and invalid backups are handled distinctly.
roadmap.dependencies: Versioned envelopes, trusted digest scope and interoperable fixtures.

roadmap.title: Optional receipt-backed training
roadmap.gate: Actual adapter tensors plus held-out improvement over a pinned base.
roadmap.dependencies: Curated real receipts, supported training representation, confirmed GPU and measured time/memory.
